en.title: The Music Box of Raindrops
en.premise: To uncover the records of a village submerged and lost thirty years ago, I came across an old device. Trapped within was a small AI that had wandered away from the network. In a room filled only with the sound of rain, the AI girl begins to weave a song of forgotten memories—an encounter that quietly stirs the echoes of a past love and the nameless emotions deep within my heart.

zh.title: 雨滴之八音盒
zh.premise: 为了追寻三十年前被淹没而消失的村庄的记录，我得到了一台旧终端。而那里，囚禁着一个从网络中迷路的小型人工智能。在只有雨声回响的房间里，AI少女开始编织起失落记忆之歌。这是一场静静摇曳着往昔之恋的残响，以及我内心深处无名之情的邂逅。
